name: University of New South Wales (UNSW Sydney)

programs.name: Science (Computer Science) BSc
programs.a_level_offer: GCE A Levels (UK) direct entry score 12 from the best two, three or four A2 subjects, with A*=6, A=5, B=4, C=3, D=2, E=1 (at least two A2 subjects needed). 2027 table and degree page.
programs.ib_offer: IB Diploma total of 34 points (only applies if the Diploma has been completed).
programs.ap_offer: US route: SAT 1240 (after 2016, with evidence of completed senior secondary studies) or ACT 26. APs with grades 4 or 5 can lower the required SAT (maximum two AP grades, Calculus AB subgrade excluded). Alone, APs are assessed on the total of at least three (maximum four) AP subjects with grades 3 or above, with a College Board score report; the table gives no numeric AP total for this degree.
programs.required_subjects: Assumed knowledge: Mathematics Extension 1 (NSW HSC level).
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT 90 overall with 23 in Writing and 22 in Reading, Listening and Speaking (old 0-120 scale; UNSW says the new TOEFL format is under review and is not being accepted until further notice). Select 'Taking TOEFL for Australia' when registering. PTE Academic 64 overall and 54 in each subtest.
programs.english_note: Engineering faculty undergraduate requirement: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each subtest (IELTS Online not accepted); results no more than two years old at the start date.
programs.notes: Term 1 2027 intake (UNSW also has Terms 2 and 3). The degree page values are the 2026 cycle (the page lists a 2026 lowest selection rank of 93.0 for domestic applicants, and a 2026 lowest offer ATAR of 85.0); the 'atar' here is the international direct-entry INT ATAR of 88 from the 2027 International Undergraduate Entry Table (https://www.unsw.edu.au/content/dam/pdfs/future-students/2027-int-ug-entry-table.pdf, row 'B Science (Computer Science)'), which also gives GCE 12, IB 34, SAT 1240, ACT 26 (the same scores the degree page shows under United States and United Kingdom). It is a guide and actual requirements may be higher or lower. Fee A$61,000 is the page's 2026 indicative first-year full fee for international students (2027 fee not shown). Program code 3778, CRICOS 015784F, Kensington campus, 144 UOC. The final Term 1 2027 completed-application date is 15 November 2026 (offers issued in rounds; earlier rounds close from 14 May 2026): https://www.unsw.edu.au/study/international-students/admissions-info. Apply via the UNSW Applicant Portal or an agent (UAC for students holding an Australian qualification). AP route: 2027 entry table key (same PDF).
